name: Storm Wyvern
fantasy: A two-legged dragon whose wings are its forelimbs, veined with lightning. It strikes with wing claws and bites, and whips its barbed tail.

directions.name: Sky
directions.desc: Dives, gales and the storm overhead: never where they strike.

skills.name: Storm Arc
skills.desc: Breathe a bolt into the nearest foe ahead. It leaps to 4 more nearby.

skills.name: Thunder Dive
skills.desc: Dive onto the pointer (12 m) in a strike of lightning: 240% weapon damage within 4 m, stunning foes for 0.8 s.

skills.name: Thunderhead
skills.desc: Summon a storm cloud over the pointer for 4 s. Every 0.5 s it strikes a foe within 5 m for 45% weapon damage. Max 2 clouds.

skills.name: Gale Wings
skills.desc: Beat your wings: everything in a 6.5 m cone ahead takes 100% weapon damage, is hurled back and slowed 40% for 2.5 s.

rites.name: Tempest
rites.text: Critical hits call lightning down: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m.

rites.name: Rending Claws
rites.text: +{dmg:attack}% claw and bite damage and +{crit}% critical chance.

rites.name: Primal Fury
rites.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} s, up to {stacks} times.

rites.name: Storm Lord
rites.text: Storm Arc and Arc deal +{dmg:storm_arc}% damage.

rites.name: Plummet
rites.text: Thunder Dive lands {dive_r}% wider, {dmg:v_dive}% harder and comes back {cd:v_dive}% sooner.

rites.name: Supercell
rites.text: Thunderhead strikes {cloud_rate}% faster, lasts {cloud_t} s longer, and each bolt has a {cloud_stun}% chance to stun.

rites.name: Hurricane
rites.text: Gale Wings reaches {gale_r}% further and hits {dmg:v_gale}% harder.

rites.name: Tailwind
rites.text: +{frw}% run speed, and Thunder Dive recharges {cd:v_dive}% faster.

rites.name: Wind-Rider
rites.text: +{dex} dexterity, and Thunder Dive and Gale Wings deal +{dmg:v_dive}% damage.

rites.name: Hunter's Updraft
rites.text: Each kill: +{frw}% run speed for {secs} s.

rites.name: Eye of the Storm
rites.text: A kill with Thunder Dive makes it ready again.

rites.name: Static Claws
rites.text: Claws leap on as lightning to {jumps} more foes ({pct}%).
